g.text: NodeMedic — controller ↔ agent ↔ NHD CR ↔ on-call UI ↔ human
(target: cf1z · Azure kubeadm; example: KubeletUnhealthy on canary node)
5'. Late-arrival race (FR-12) — agent finishes after deadline
If the agent did not write status.diagnosis before
spec.budgets.deadline, the controller marks the NHD
Failed (after retry-once is exhausted) and Slack
posts a "Critical" message. The agent keeps running
with no agent-side cancellation. When emit_report
finally fires, the writer detects phase=Failed and
decision wins, and the late tool calls live in
stdout logs (durable for the pod's lifetime only).
GET NHD/<name> + GET Node/<n> + GET pods
(modal lists pods that will be evicted)
